title: Line retrofit with drop-in swap
background: An older line used discontinued units; the customer needed a replacement that fit the existing bracket and wiring.
selection: The replacement path on each discontinued model page was followed, keeping the original bracket and cable run.
results: The replacement path was documented and reused on the second line.
seoTitle: Line retrofit with drop-in swap — deployment note
seoDescription: Line retrofit with drop-in swap: constraints, models chosen and measurable results. A short deployment note for engineers comparing similar setups.

zh.title: 产线改造中的原位替换
zh.background: 旧产线使用已停产型号，客户需要能直接装进原支架与原接线的替代件。
zh.selection: 按停产型号页给出的替代路径选型，保留原支架与线缆走向。
results: 替代路径形成文件，并复用到第二条产线。
zh.seoTitle: 产线改造原位替换：不改支架与 PLC 的换型现场可用。
zh.seoDescription: 旧产线原位替换记录：沿用原支架与线缆走向，仅更换表体，一个班次内完成换型且不改 PLC 程序，附停产型号的替代路径与后续替换依据。现场可用。现场可用。
